name: OpenShaders
summary: Open-source home for web shaders: a free shader library, a live WebGL/WebGPU editor and React components, pre-launch.
description: OpenShaders is building the largest collection of web shaders for real websites: light, texture and movement you can use in your own projects. Planned: a free open-source shader library, a live WebGL/WebGPU shader editor, ready-to-use React components and JavaScript modules, and a shadcn registry for installing shaders from the terminal. Until launch, visitors can claim a username and get a shader generated from their name.
